phase.decide: Look at your hand and the trump, then choose to enter or drop. **Dropping costs only the ante**; entering and falling short of the required tricks costs an extra payment and doubles your next ante.

header.pot: Pot: {{pot}} chips (shared out by tricks taken)
header.risk: Enter and take fewer than {{required}} trick(s) and you pay an extra {{penalty}} into the pot — and your ante doubles next hand.

watching: You dropped out of this round. Watching it play out.

hint.julepePlayIn: You hold trumps or high cards — this is worth playing.

hint.julepeTakeTrick: No trick yet. Take one to avoid the extra payment.
hint.julepeAlreadySafe: You have made the required tricks — now take what you can.

tutorial.pot: Chips staked on this round, shared out among whoever takes tricks. It grows every time a player owes the extra payment.
